description: Image Description: Two Afghan Hounds are lying on a sidewalk next to a road, tethered to a rusty metal pole. The dog on the left has long, sleek black fur and is wearing a red bandana with white polka dots around its head. The dog on the right has lighter, shaggy fur that appears to be a mix of gray and beige, and it also wears a similar red polka-dotted bandana. Both dogs are resting calmly, with their heads slightly raised
